elements.requirement: Information contained in a historical record in the Public Record Office or the Public Record Office of Northern Ireland cannot be exempt information by virtue of section 21 or 22.

elements.requirement: Section 2(3) shall have effect with the omission of the reference to section 23 in relation to any information falling within section 23(1) that is contained in a historical record in the Public Record Office or the Public Record Office of Northern Ireland.
